title: Approval of the Appropriation of $30,543,000: For the Terminal 4 Concessions Project at Los Angeles International Airport (Hans Thilenius)
text:
[REGULAR ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Regular Items 10 - 14]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Appropriation of $30,543,000: For the Terminal 4 Concessions Project at Los Angeles International Airport (Hans Thilenius)
summary: The Board is asked to approve $30,543,000 for the Terminal 4 concessions project at Los Angeles International Airport.
